title: Transfer roundup: Sako to rejoin Palace, Chelsea's Moses loaned to Fenerbahce
trail: Crystal Palace are set to re-sign Bakary Sako from West Brom, while Chelsea’s Victor Moses has left for Turkey on an 18-month loan
body: Crystal Palace are to re-sign the Mali international Bakary Sako from West Brom, with the player having undergone a medical at the club’s Beckenham training centre. Sako departed Selhurst Park last summer after three injury-affected seasons. He had suffered a badly broken ankle in his final appearance for the club, at West Ham a little under a year ago. Palace had still been keen to re-sign the free agent on reduced terms once his contract expired in July, but had already filled their 25-man Premier League squad by the time the summer transfer deadline passed. The winger duly joined West Brom on a one-year contract worth around £30,000 a week but returned to fitness only in late October and has only made two league starts. West Brom are attempting to secure Newcastle’s Jacob Murphy in as a replacement and have an interest in Fulham’s Kevin McDonald and Tyrone Mings at Bournemouth. Sako, who scored six goals under Roy Hodgson last season to help Palace recover from a dreadful start in the Premier League, will return to provide cover up front and wide, with club effectively taking on the last six months of his contract. The 30-year-old’s arrival will end Palace’s interest in re-signing Yannick Bolasie from Everton. He will join the Brazilian goalkeeper Lucas Perri in arriving at Selhurst Park this month, with the 21-year-old having signed initially on a six-month loan from São Paulo. The 21-year-old is very much considered a prospect for the future, with his arrival not linked to the injuries recently suffered by Vicente Guaita and Wayne Hennessey. The latter also potentially faces a five-game ban with the FA investigating whether he was caught performing a Nazi salute at a recent team dinner. The Wales international denies doing so. Perri could be on the bench on Sunday against Spurs, when Julián Speroni will play his 405th game for Palace despite his difficult return at Anfield last weekend. Palace are hopeful Hennessey could be available after a thigh complaint for next week’s trip to Southampton. Moses joins Fenerbahce on 18-month loan Victor Moses has signed for Fenerbahce on an 18-month loan from Chelsea after falling out of favour under Maurizio Sarri. Moses has not featured since October after making six appearances in all competitions, starting just once. The Nigerian international is leaving Stamford Bridge on loan for the fourth time after spells at Liverpool, Stoke and West Ham. The 28-year-old played a key role as a wing-back in Antonio Conte’s 3-4-3 system in 2016-17 as Chelsea won the Premier League, signing a contract extension that season until 2021. “Victor Moses has today joined Fenerbahce on loan until the end of the 2019-20 season,” A club statement said. “We wish Victor, a popular member of the squad, all the best on his loan deal in Turkey.” PA
